character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A corrupted mall retail employee enemy for a 1990s American shopping mall horror roguelite. Humanoid dressed in a 1990s mall store uniform: a teal polyester vest over a white short-sleeve shirt, a small blank rectangular badge containing NO lettering, dark trousers, black shoes. Corruption has partly taken the body: one arm stretched too long, the skin pale grey with dark veins, and the vest stained and torn along one shoulder. POSTURE: SEVERELY HUNCHED - the back is strongly rounded and the whole upper body folds forward and down, the head thrust out low and ahead of the chest with almost no neck visible, both arms dangling straight down in front of the knees, and the shoulders rolled forward. The silhouette MUST read as a rounded HUMPED mass - wider and shorter than a normal standing figure, with a pronounced hump at the top of the back. CRITICAL: the teal vest, white shirt and blank badge stay clearly recognisable as a mall store employee. STYLE: detailed late-SNES pixel art, crisp hard pixels, clean deliberate clusters, selective outlines, minimal dithering, no anti-aliasing, no blur. LIGHTING: neutral overhead fluorescent mall lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
